parsed.text: Panel p0 current distributions (represented time 12) for nodes n0–n3 are uniform 4×4 for both red and blue; these are inherited/copied prior records, not new estimates. Conditional command candidate records differ only at node n2. Under command k0 (candidate) blue mass concentrates on the top-right 2×2 cells ([0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]) while red concentrates on the top-left 2×2 ([0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]). Under command k1 (candidate) blue peaks strongly at [0,2] and red peaks strongly at [0,1]. Under command k2 (candidate) node n2 is uniform for both roles. Other nodes remain uniform across all candidate commands. Conditional command records are presented as estimates conditional on each command, not as events that have occurred.
